messages:
Iris (AE): Heads-up — Hollow LLC sent an RFI + capability checklist. They want technical answers, security questionnaire, POC SOW and a price range. Deadline Tue COB. Uploaded: /shared/hollow/rfi/hollow_rfi_v2.xlsx. Can we split?

Diego (SE): I’ll take the capability matrix and perf numbers. Need to know expected embed vs gen ratio — Iris can you confirm sample traffic?

Iris (AE): Sample: 80% embeddings (short, ~256 tokens), 20% generations (avg 800 tokens). They asked for 100/500/1000 QPS sizing.

Marta (Security): I’ll own the security questionnaire. Looks like BYOK/HSM and PCI rows to answer. I’ll flag legal items.

Ben (Pricing): I’ll draft pricing bands for 4-week POC (Dedicated) and optional Private week. Diego — can you give token/sec numbers by EOD?

Diego (SE): Quick est: 100 QPS embed -> ~25k tokens/sec; 1000 QPS -> ~250k tokens/sec. Will add exact table.

Marta (Security): Sample answers: TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest, role-based access, optional log export to customer bucket. For PCI attestation we need scoped engagement — flagging @Liam.

Liam (Legal): I’ll review flags. Also confirm export control and indemnity language if they ask about third-party models.

Iris (AE): POC SOW sketch: Week0 infra & peering; Week1-2 perf + ingest; Week3 security checks + optional Private trial; Week4 reporting & handoff. Include on-site audit as paid add-on.

Ben (Pricing): I’ll produce pricing_sheet.csv and poc_sow.pdf and upload to /shared/hollow/rfi/submission/. Drive-bot create snapshot when ready.

drive-bot: Snapshot: https://drive.internal/s/hollow/rfi/submission/ :white_check_mark:

Diego (SE): Capability note for matrix: "Function calling + structured output supported on Hosted/Dedicated; Private requires runtime >=2.1 and control-plane egress allowlist."

Iris (AE): Timeline: Diego by Mon 11am for matrix, Marta Mon 2pm for security draft, Ben Mon 4pm for pricing. I’ll consolidate Tue morning for final review.
